title: Act: Implement the manifest loader
summary: loadManifest with reference validation and fallbacks
acceptance_criteria: Returns report with errors, dangling, missing

steps.action: Export loadManifest(manifestData: unknown, scene: unknown, exists: (assetPath:string)=>boolean): {manifest: AssetManifest|null; scene: SceneContent|null; errors: string[]; missing: string[]; dangling: {objectId:string; asset:string}[]}. Use safeParse for both; on failure push `path: message` strings to errors. For each manifest asset where !exists(path) push id to missing. For each scene object whose asset is not a manifest id push to dangling. Wrap in try/catch to never throw. Export FALLBACK_ASSET (id 'fallback', type 'object', path 'ui/frames/fallback.png') and resolveAsset(report, id) returning the manifest entry or FALLBACK_ASSET when id is missing from manifest or in report.missing
